mapper.select: SELECT model_id, model_code, model_name, adapter_type, task_type, weights_path, labels_json::text AS labels_json, conf_threshold, iou_threshold, vlm_review_enabled, vlm_trigger_conf, applicable_places, is_default, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_time FROM ehs_vision_model WHERE model_code = #{modelCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ehs_vision_model ( model_code, model_name, adapter_type, task_type, weights_path, labels_json, conf_threshold, iou_threshold, vlm_review_enabled, vlm_trigger_conf, applicable_places, is_default, status, remark, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{modelCode}, #{modelName}, #{adapterType}, COALESCE(#{taskType}, 'detect'), #{weightsPath}, CAST(COALESCE(#{labelsJson}, '[]') AS jsonb), COALESCE(#{confThreshold}, 0.35), COALESCE(#{iouThreshold}, 0.45), COALESCE(#{vlmReviewEnabled}, TRUE), COALESCE(#{vlmTriggerConf}, 0.75), COALESCE(#{applicablePlaces}, 'production,storage,auxiliary'), COALESCE(#{isDefault}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{status}, '0'), #{remark}, COALESCE(#{createBy}, 'admin'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT p.point_id, p.point_code, p.point_name, p.place_type, p.dept_id, d.dept_name, p.hazard_id, h.hazard_name, p.default_model_id, m.model_code AS default_model_code, p.stream_protocol, p.stream_url, p.map_x, p.map_y, p.status, p.create_time FROM ehs_camera_point p LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON p.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN ehs_hazard_profile h ON p.hazard_id = h.hazard_id LEFT JOIN ehs_vision_model m ON p.default_model_id = m.model_id WHERE p.point_id = #{pointId}

SELECT a.alert_id, a.alert_no, a.point_id, p.point_name, a.dept_id, d.dept_name, a.place_type, a.model_code, a.prompt_text, a.raw_image_url, a.annotated_image_url, a.detections_json::text AS detections_json, a.inference_ms, a.vlm_reviewed, a.vlm_model, a.is_real_hazard, a.violation_type, a.severity, a.vlm_description, a.vlm_suggestion, a.cited_laws_json::text AS cited_laws_json, a.handle_status, a.order_id, a.create_by, a.create_time FROM ehs_vision_alert a LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON a.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN ehs_camera_point p ON a.point_id = p.point_id WHERE a.alert_id = #{alertId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ehs_vision_alert ( alert_no, point_id, dept_id, place_type, model_code, prompt_text, raw_image_url, annotated_image_url, detections_json, inference_ms, vlm_reviewed, vlm_model, is_real_hazard, violation_type, severity, vlm_description, vlm_suggestion, cited_laws_json, handle_status, order_id, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{alertNo}, #{pointId}, #{deptId}, COALESCE(#{placeType}, 'production'), #{modelCode}, #{promptText}, #{rawImageUrl}, #{annotatedImageUrl}, CAST(COALESCE(#{detectionsJson}, '[]') AS jsonb), COALESCE(#{inferenceMs}, 0), COALESCE(#{vlmReviewed}, FALSE), #{vlmModel}, COALESCE(#{isRealHazard}, TRUE), #{violationType}, COALESCE(#{severity}, 'MEDIUM'), #{vlmDescription}, #{vlmSuggestion}, CAST(COALESCE(#{citedLawsJson}, '[]') AS jsonb), COALESCE(#{handleStatus}, 'PENDING'), #{orderId}, COALESCE(#{createBy}, 'admin'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ehs_vision_alert WHERE is_real_hazard = TRUE AND handle_status != 'DISMISSED' AND create_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 days' AND dept_id = #{deptId}
SELECT severity, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM ehs_vision_alert WHERE is_real_hazard = TRUE GROUP BY severity
